plugins.name: mentor
plugins.description: A lean planning harness for Claude Code: an edit gate keeps the repo read-only until the plan is approved, then implementation and verification both run subagents-first — every verification topic checked by its own fresh single-focus agent.

plugins.name: loom
plugins.description: Session harvesting and plugin lifecycle tools: harvest sessions into reusable artifacts, learn from a plugin's sessions to auto-improve and republish it, track usage, run it all daily unattended, and email a summary of what changed — each install isolated to its own config dir.

plugins.name: tmux-design
plugins.description: A design standard for tmux console surfaces: panes render themed, column-correct, in-place-refreshing content instead of raw text, verified live in the pane rather than assumed from a file edit.
